decisions: Landing motion pass: Outfit headings with Jakarta Sans body, code-native layered service illustrations, duotone Lucide role emblems, gentle pointer tilt and viewport-scoped scanning/float animations. Provide pause and prefers-reduced-motion support; preserve ivory and forest-green identity.

Service interiors: shared sage cards and native accessible dialogs; split ticket list/details, searchable saved notices with a separate inbox, resident passes with validated date inputs and a weekly meal picker. Explicitly label demo outpasses rather than presenting placeholder QR icons as valid passes.
Second UI pass: use forest green, sage and neutral surfaces with a compact desktop workspace sidebar.
Keep the warm collegiate personality while replacing heavy black outlines and offset shadows with soft borders and low elevation.
Prioritize an always-visible module navigation, 44px minimum controls, visible keyboard focus, and reduced-motion support.
Show record-derived metrics, an interactive weekday schedule, campus shortcuts and notices on the overview.
Use a two-column expandable services menu on phones, with URL-backed module navigation and browser Back support.

Public landing page: ivory and forest-green editorial design, italic serif headline accents, product previews from sample data, feature and role sections, and native FAQ disclosure. Public home is #landing; the existing dashboard is #overview.
